# CineTrack - Cinema Tracker & Movie Discovery

> CineTrack is a modern, high-performance web application designed for movie lovers to discover trending titles, track personal watchlists, rate films, and curate custom movie collections.

## Core Capabilities
- **Featured Spotlight Carousel**: Top-5 trending movies of the week with interactive auto-advancing banner.
- **Real-Time Movie Discovery**: Search and discover movies powered by TMDB metadata, posters, and trailers.
- **Personal Watchlist & Library**: Track status ("Plan to Watch", "Watching", "Completed"), log 1-10 star ratings, and write personal reviews.
- **Custom Collections**: Create and organize custom movie lists.
- **Multi-User Sync & Offline Guest Mode**: Real-time cloud sync via Supabase Auth & PostgreSQL, with local storage fallback for instant guest access.

## Target Audience & Use Cases
- Film enthusiasts seeking a clean, fast alternative for tracking watched movies and watchlists.
- Users looking to curate custom collections and discover trending releases.

## Website Architecture & Key Routes
- `/`: Featured Spotlight, Trending Now, and Popular Releases.
- `/search`: Real-time movie search engine.
- `/library`: Personal movie watchlist & rating library.
- `/collections`: User-created movie collections.
